newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life says 1996 new business up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sun Life says 1996 new business up 11 pct.

text.p: Sun Life and Provincial Holdings' subsidiary, Sun Life Corporation said on Friday that total new business rose 11 percent to 263.7 million stg in 1996.
Total new business is calculated by the industry convention of new regular premiums plus one tenth of single premiums.
Total regular premiums grew 13 percent to 145 million stg while single premiums increased 9 percent to 1,187.2 million stg.

"Following two difficult years for the industry it is encouraging that the return to growth in the UK life and pensions market which I forecast a year ago is starting to come through," said Sun Life's managing director Les Owen.
"I am pleased with our results which show improvements across most sectors of our business."

Owen said he expected 1997 to provide further growth in the market, but not to the extent seen in 1996. He also said he expected the market to remain "intensely competitive" and pressure on margins and profitability to continue.
